description: This file defines a class that handles data URI schemes specifically for base64-encoded images, including validation, image type detection, and content rewriting.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_data
classes.description: Class for handling data URI schemes for base64 images, including validation of image data and content type adjustments.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates and processes a data URI to ensure it is a supported image type, decodes the base64 content, writes it temporarily to determine the image type, and rewrites the URI if valid.

methods.name: muteErrorHandler
methods.description: A placeholder error handler used during getimagesize calls to suppress warnings.
